script: This is proof that Steph Curry changed basketball forever. You see, the NBA was once dominated by big players and focused more on physical play. But Steph Curry rewrote the rules of the game. Instead of fighting in the midrange, he stepped behind the three-point line and started knocking down shots. Steph Curry was turning the impossible shot into his normal shot, making him the greatest shooter of all time. Even LeBron James started copying parts of Steph Curry's style on the court. Today, almost every NBA team plays differently because of Steph Curry.
